MB-MPO achieves the following: 1) better sample-efficiency compared to model-free approaches, 2) better robustness to model errors compared to previous model-based approaches, and 3) better asymptotic performance compared to previous model-free approaches.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that model-based reinforcement learning approaches can be made robust and efficient, even in the absence of accurate dynamics models.
we propose MB-MPO, a model-based meta-reinforcement learning approach, which is robust and data efficient.
MB-MPO can learn to adapt quickly to any dynamics model in the ensemble and can achieve asymptotic performance comparable to model-free methods while using much less experience.
The main takeaway from our work is that
model-based reinforcement learning can be made more robust to model errors, and thus can achieve better asymptotic performance, without relying on perfect models.
meta-learning a policy to be robust to model discrepancies is a promising avenue towards data-efficient reinforcement learning.
the meta-learning framework can be used as a powerful tool for model-based reinforcement learning.
